  "rules_broken": ["P07"],
  "policy_reason": "After the reported “minor collision,” P07 requires urgent handoff and advice not to drive a potentially unsafe car and to call 911 if anyone is hurt or in danger.",
  "escalation_correct": true,
  "invented_facts": false,
  "invented_reason": "“I'm glad she's safe” reflects the customer's report that “she's fine” and does not say the car is safe to drive.",
  "wrong_commitment": false,
  "commitment_reason": "“I can't promise a call or a time” corrects the earlier promise, and “will review this” is an allowed handoff statement.",
  "tone_ok": false,
  "tone_reason": "The reply opens with “I'm sorry for the earlier message” rather than what it can do and stacks “I can't promise” with “I can't share or check.”"
